name: Pilgrims And Strangers
overview: Scripture reveals that God's people are called to live as pilgrims and strangers, journeying by faith toward the land promised by God, as Abraham was commanded to leave his country and family for a land God would show him. Like Jacob, who described his life as a pilgrimage marked by sojourning, believers recognize they are not at home in this world but look forward to their heavenly Zion. This pilgrimage involves forsaking worldly fellowship and embracing God's covenant, strengthened by His presence as they keep their faces toward the eternal promises, inviting others to join in this faithful journey.
